source_dataset: MIMIC-IV v3.1 (ICU cohort, 5000 patients / 6500 admissions / 7210 ICU stays)
cohort_filter: cohort.csv rows with cohort_type='icu', cohort_label='ICU' (one row per hadm_id that had at least one ICU stay)
description: 13 structured csv files (7 top-level + 4 icu + 2 multimodal/ecg). Split key is stay_id (not hadm_id). scorer grades all 13 via equal_file_row_aligned_v1. summary.json is metadata only and is intentionally NOT in reference/ (the harness walks reference/ recursively and would fail load_evaluation_manifest's key_columns check on summary.json). multimodal/notes.csv is not included because ICU_5000 source has no discharge notes.

cohort.csv.notes: cohort table; one row per hadm_id that has at least one ICU stay; subject_id + hadm_id is the unique row key

demographics.csv.notes: subject-keyed (one row per subject). Routed to whichever split owns the subject via the stay→subject mapping.

medications.csv.notes: all 8 columns used as a composite key; raw may contain ~6 dup rows after compression

icu/icustays.csv.notes: one row per ICU stay; the split key

icu/chartevents.csv.notes: all 7 columns used as a composite key; raw may contain ~70 dup rows after compression

multimodal/ecg_manifest.csv.notes: ECG study manifest; one row per ECG study, has stay_id to join back to ICU stay

multimodal/ecg_measurements.csv.notes: ECG measurements + 18 free-text report fields (report_0..report_17) + 11 numerical measurements (rr_interval, p_onset, p_end, qrs_onset, qrs_end, t_end, p_axis, qrs_axis, t_axis, bandwidth, filtering, cart_id). Score via row-keyed alignment only on study_id; report fields and measurement columns are scored as-is.

_auxiliary_files._comment: summary.json is intentionally NOT in 'files'. scorer would error trying to extract columns from a JSON document, and load_evaluation_manifest would raise 'missing key configuration: summary.json'. summary.json stays in the source split tree (e.g. /Users/mac/Downloads/ICU_5000_split_10_20_rest/<split>/summary.json) but is NOT copied into the reference/ tree used by the harness.

summary.json.expected_role: kept in source split; not part of scoring

absent_files._comment: Files NOT present in ICU_5000 source that might be expected in other MIMIC-IV tasks.
absent_files.multimodal/notes.csv: ICU_5000 source has no discharge notes; this file is omitted from 'files' to avoid 'manifest references unknown gold files'.
